outcome: Smooth muscle actin in pulmonary vasculature
cohort: 93 preterm infants treated with iNO in the first 28 days of life, compared with 930 matched controls
finding: Preterm infants with HRF exposed to antenatal steroids and pPROM had improved oxygenation with iNO and survival without severe IVH/PVL.
mod_finding: Preterm infants with hypoxemic respiratory failure who were born via c-section had improved oxygenation with inhaled nitric oxide and survival without severe intraventricular hemorrhage/periventricular leukomalacia.
